historical-trends.looks: A heading, a large line chart of yearly values, then a row of trend cards (title, text, link).
historical-trends.use: A multi-year trend with commentary, when the source gives the yearly figures.
historical-trends.avoid: Without real yearly figures from the source. Never make up chart values.

fields.chartPoints: One per line as Year|Value, e.g. 2023|36200000.
